finding.expected: A successful integration operation must prove the exact canonical remote integration ref exists at the intended candidate SHA before returning success or before Preflight/Unified State may consume it in remote mode. Check push outcome; on push failure fail closed and ensure local-only staging cannot become authoritative (rollback the local ref or make admission require the exact remote ref). Add a regression that forces remote push failure/missing remote integration ref and proves integrate-correction is non-success, Preflight/Unified State remain INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, no REMEDIATION RUN is created, and no Executor is invoked.
finding.issue: Integration publication/readiness is not fail closed. integrate_correction creates the local aios/integration ref before pushing, performs git push with allow_fail=True, ignores the push return code, and still returns success. resolve_valid_integration then prefers that local ref, and Unified State/Correction Preflight consume it as a valid integrated base. A network/auth/non-fast-forward push failure can therefore leave canonical remote without the exact integration ref while local state transitions to remediation-ready and can admit Executor execution. Publication later checks the remote ref, but that is too late and violates AC5's requirement that readiness/execution consume only the exact valid integration candidate.
